evidence.finding: The church-building polygon has representative point 59.37966, 10.72254 and is linked to Wikidata Q6494456.
The entity links OSM way 370049162, Kulturminne ID 85325 and Church of Norway building ID 280, gives address Kirkeveien 280 and lies approximately 4.4 metres from the applied building point.
SNL dates the church to around 1170, identifies it as automatically protected and describes it as little changed since the Middle Ages with major surviving medieval fabric and inventory.
The church lies directly on Borgleden and is described as one of Østfold's largest and best-preserved medieval churches, with distinctive ashlar masonry and medieval inventory.
